title: Hatsune Miku — Powerful Smile〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll carry the dishes...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thanks for the help, Miku.
But you know...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's so quiet without everyone here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Are you feeling lonely...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Maybe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've had that look on your face since they left too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You noticed?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Seeing them talk about their New Year's resolutions made me think back to how they were when we all first met.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, I know what you mean.
They've come a long way, haven't they?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is this place really the result of both our feelings?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Kohane's really changed her look since then.
She used to have long hair and wore glasses...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She'd only just met An and didn't understand her own feelings yet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But then...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: After An shared her dream with me, I decided to sing as best I could...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My... My true feelings...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to put on an event that will surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She acknowledged her lack of resolve, as well as her shortcomings, and found the determination to tackle them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks to that resolve, Kohane managed to discover what it was that she really wanted.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was so happy to see that moment of realization too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Meanwhile, Len was sulking because he was looking forward to hanging out with Toya and Akito, but they didn't want to come to SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah. I remember that.
But you sorted that out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, it wasn't all me. Len played his part too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I have a friend who's really important to me, too.
We're always together, and it's so much fun when we sing, but...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We still fight sometimes, so I kind of understand.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It always feels really lonely after you fight with someone close to you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, so that's how it went.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe it struck a chord with them because it was Len who said that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It'll be interesting to see how their group evolves from here on out.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... But something tells me you already have an idea, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm not a fortune teller...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But that's not to say I haven't been thinking about some possible outcomes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? Won't you share them with me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, for example... Right now Kohane is focusing on improving her skills to match her friends.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But one day, she could end up being the strongest member of their group. Things like that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I could see that happening. Once she sets her mind to something, she really commits and never wavers.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Exactly. But the rest of the group won't be content with how things are now either.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
They may be friends,
but they're also all very competitive.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Well, it's just one interesting possibility.
It'd be great if I turned out to be right.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're really hoping for it, aren't you...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is it because you want them to reach a level where they become your rivals?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, was it too obvious?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. I saw right through you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I mean, you're all so competitive.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In fact, I'd like nothing more than for them to exceed my expectations.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That would make me the happiest.
